title: Storyville drummer Marcus Foster and Lester's 'tiddy-voo'
summary: Following Lester into Storyville, Freeman hears from drummer Marcus Foster that Lester told him only to 'tiddy-voo'.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Now, I followed Lester Young into Storyville and I used the same rhythm section. There was a black drummer by the name of Marcus Foster who had just adored Lester Young. Lester Young was his god, and so I told him that I was a dear friend of Lester Young, and I said, 'What was the first thing Lester Young ever said to you?' and Marcus

said, 'Well, I asked Lester how I should play behind him, as I am asking you.' I said, 'Well, just play.' Lester said to him, 'Man, all I want you to do is just tiddy-voo,' which to me, you know, this wonderful sense of humor.
And he said it was the most delightful thing.
